description.zh:
接受授权的VBR实例的范围。取值：

- **All**：将VPC实例授权给指定地域和阿里云账号（主账号）下所有的VBR实例，此时**VbrInstanceIds**参数可以为空。
- **Specify**：将VPC实例授权给指定VBR实例，此时**VbrInstanceIds**参数需要配置。
description.en:
The scope of VBR instances that accept the authorization. Valid values:

- **All**: Grants authorization of the VPC instance to all VBR instances in the specified region under the specified Alibaba Cloud account. In this case, the **VbrInstanceIds** parameter can be left empty.
- **Specify**: Grants authorization of the VPC instance to the specified VBR instances. In this case, the **VbrInstanceIds** parameter is required.
The ID of the VPC instance for which authorization is to be granted.

description.zh:
要授权的VPC实例所在的地域ID。

您可以通过调用[DescribeRegions](~~36063~~)接口获取地域ID。
description.en:
The region ID of the VPC instance for which authorization is to be granted.

You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~36063~~) operation to query region IDs.

description.zh: 接受授权的VBR实例的列表信息。
description.en: The list of VBR instances to be granted authorization.

description.zh: 接受授权的VBR实例所属阿里云账号（主账号）ID。
description.en: The Alibaba Cloud account ID that owns the VBR instance to be granted authorization.

description.zh: 接受授权的VBR实例所在的地域ID。
description.en: The region ID of the VBR instance to be granted authorization.

title.zh: 将跨账号创建VBR上连场景的VPC实例授权给VBR实例
title.en: Grant authorization of a VPC instance to a VBR instance for cross-account VBR uplink scenarios

descriptions.zh: 创建跨账号VBR上连时，您需要将VPC实例授权给VBR实例。
descriptions.en: When creating a cross-account VBR uplink connection, you must grant authorization of the VPC instance to the VBR instance.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun vpc grant-instance-to-vbr --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --vbr-owner-uid 1210123456123456 --vbr-instance-ids vbr-m5ex0xf63xk8s5bob0000,vbr-bp1h6efd7a5g66xxd0000 --instance-id vpc-bp1lqhq93q8evjpky0000 --grant-type All --vbr-region-no cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
